name: Star Timer Damage Amount
description: Sets how much "Star Timer as Health Bar" drains per hit, in on-screen units (default 10). Edit the hex byte in the `org ... : db $XX` line - e.g. 05 = drain 5, 0A = drain 10. Requires "Star Timer as Health Bar" enabled and ordered before this patch (it defines the StarTimerReducer label this overwrites); otherwise the build fails.
details: asm patch: overwrites the reducer's amount operand - the low byte of StarTimerReducer's 'LDA #$00xx' (StarTimerReducer+1), which the reducer multiplies by 10 internally. Both patches assemble in the same YI_ApplyPatchesPostAssembly pass, so this in-place `org` references StarTimerReducer directly (no label-form chunk, no post-build symbol lookup) and tracks the patch-pool relocation. If "Star Timer as Health Bar" isn't enabled (or is ordered after this patch) the label is undefined and asar fails the build loudly - no silent skip.
asm: ; Override the drain operand of 'Star Timer as Health Bar's reducer: the low byte
; multiplies by 10 internally. e.g. db $05 = drain 5, db $0A = drain 10.
; StarTimerReducer is defined by 'Star Timer as Health Bar' in the same
; post-assembly pass, so this in-place org resolves it directly (build fails
; loudly if that patch is disabled or ordered after this one).
org StarTimerReducer+1 : db $0A          ; drain amount (on-screen units)
